tasks.title: Create Bicep Infrastructure Modules
tasks.description: Build modular Bicep templates for Azure Container Apps infrastructure including environment, container app, networking, monitoring, and security components
tasks.details: Create reusable Bicep modules that accept parameters from payload and deploy Azure Container Apps infrastructure. Follow Azure naming conventions and include proper tagging for cost tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate Bicep syntax with 'az bicep build'. Test deployment to dev resource group. Verify outputs (FQDN, resource IDs) are returned correctly.

tasks.title: Build Argo Workflow Templates for CREATE Operation
tasks.description: Implement Argo Workflow for creating Azure Container Apps with validation, Bicep deployment, verification, and notification steps
tasks.details: Create WorkflowTemplate with steps: validate payload, pre-deployment checks, execute Bicep via Azure CLI container, verify deployment health, send notifications. Use azure-cli container image with Service Principal authentication.
tasks.testStrategy: Test workflow execution with sample payload. Verify each step completes successfully. Validate Azure resources are created. Test rollback on failure.

tasks.title: Build Argo Workflow Templates for DELETE Operation
tasks.description: Implement Argo Workflow for deleting Azure Container Apps with backup, graceful termination, and cleanup steps
tasks.details: Create WorkflowTemplate with steps: backup configuration, validate deletion request, execute Azure CLI delete commands, cleanup associated resources, send completion notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Test deletion of test Container Apps. Verify graceful shutdown. Ensure configuration backup is saved. Validate cleanup of all resources.

tasks.title: Set up Argo Events EventSource and Sensor
tasks.description: Configure Argo Events to receive webhook events and trigger appropriate workflows based on operation type
tasks.details: Create EventSource for HTTP webhook endpoint. Build Sensor to parse payload, filter by operation type (create/delete), and trigger corresponding workflows with payload parameters.
tasks.testStrategy: Deploy EventSource and Sensor to argo-events namespace. Test webhook endpoint accessibility. Verify event routing to correct workflows.

tasks.title: Build REST API for Payload Submission
tasks.description: Create Next.js API endpoints for receiving Container App provisioning payloads with validation and event publishing
tasks.details: Implement POST /api/v1/container-apps endpoint. Add JSON schema validation. Publish validated payload to Argo Events webhook. Return request ID and workflow ID to client.
tasks.testStrategy: Test API with valid and invalid payloads. Verify validation errors are returned. Confirm events are published to Argo Events. Check response format.

tasks.title: Configure Azure Service Principal Authentication
tasks.description: Set up Azure Service Principal for Argo Workflows to authenticate and execute Azure CLI commands
tasks.details: Create Azure Service Principal with appropriate RBAC permissions. Store credentials in Kubernetes secrets. Configure Argo Workflows to use credentials for Azure authentication.
tasks.testStrategy: Test Azure login from workflow pod. Verify permissions for resource group creation, Container App deployment. Validate credential rotation process.

tasks.title: Implement Payload JSON Schema Validation
tasks.description: Define and implement JSON schema for Container App payload validation with comprehensive error messages
tasks.details: Create JSON schema covering all payload fields (operation, metadata, containerApp, environment). Implement validation in API and workflow validation step. Provide clear error messages for schema violations.
tasks.testStrategy: Test validation with various payload combinations. Verify required fields are enforced. Check error messages are helpful. Validate nested objects.

tasks.title: Add Basic Logging and Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement structured logging for API requests and workflow execution with error tracking
tasks.details: Add structured logging to API endpoints and workflow steps. Log payload validation, Azure CLI execution, deployment results. Implement error capture and reporting. Send failure notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Review logs for successful deployments. Verify error conditions are logged. Test notification delivery on failures. Check log searchability.

tasks.title: Create Simple Web UI for Payload Submission
tasks.description: Build basic Next.js form interface for creating Container App payloads with real-time preview
tasks.details: Create form with fields for all payload properties. Add real-time JSON preview. Implement form validation. Submit to API endpoint. Display request status and workflow ID.
tasks.testStrategy: Test form submission with various inputs. Verify validation feedback. Check JSON preview accuracy. Confirm API integration works. Test error display.

tasks.title: Replace Firebase Auth with Azure AD Integration
tasks.description: Replace existing Firebase authentication with Azure AD OAuth2 for user authentication
tasks.details: Remove Firebase dependencies. Install and configure @azure/msal-react. Update AuthContext to use MSAL. Configure Azure AD app registration. Implement token-based API authentication.
tasks.testStrategy: Test Azure AD login flow. Verify tokens are obtained. Check API authentication with bearer tokens. Validate logout functionality.

tasks.title: Add Azure CLI Container Image to Workflows
tasks.description: Configure Argo Workflows to use official Azure CLI container image for executing deployment commands
tasks.details: Use mcr.microsoft.com/azure-cli:latest image in workflow steps. Configure environment variables for authentication. Mount Bicep templates as ConfigMaps or artifacts. Test Azure CLI command execution.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify container image pulls successfully. Test az login with Service Principal. Execute test Bicep deployment. Validate command outputs.

tasks.title: Implement Workflow Health Check and Verification
tasks.description: Add post-deployment health checks and verification steps to ensure Container Apps are running correctly
tasks.details: Add verification step to workflow using curl or Azure CLI. Check Container App status, replica count, and FQDN accessibility. Implement retry logic. Fail workflow if health check fails.
tasks.testStrategy: Test health checks for successful deployments. Verify failure detection for unhealthy apps. Check retry logic works. Validate timeout handling.

tasks.title: Set Up Kubernetes Secrets Management
tasks.description: Create and manage Kubernetes secrets for Azure credentials, API keys, and notification webhooks
tasks.details: Create secrets for Azure Service Principal credentials, Slack/Teams webhooks, and any API keys. Document secret creation process. Implement secret rotation strategy.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify secrets are created in correct namespaces. Test workflow access to secrets. Validate secret values are not exposed in logs.

tasks.title: Create GET Endpoint for Container App Status
tasks.description: Implement API endpoint to retrieve status and details of deployed Container Apps
tasks.details: Create GET /api/v1/container-apps/{name} endpoint. Query Azure to get Container App status, revisions, FQDN, and metrics. Return structured response with deployment info.
tasks.testStrategy: Test status retrieval for existing apps. Verify response format matches spec. Check error handling for non-existent apps. Test with different resource groups.

tasks.title: Add Notification Webhooks (Slack/Teams)
tasks.description: Implement notification system to send deployment status updates to Slack or Microsoft Teams
tasks.details: Add workflow steps to send notifications on success/failure. Support Slack and Teams webhook formats. Include deployment details, workflow ID, and relevant links in notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Test notifications for successful deployments. Verify failure notifications include error details. Check message formatting. Validate webhook integration.

tasks.title: Document MVP Setup and Usage
tasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation for setting up and using the MVP platform
tasks.details: Document architecture overview, setup prerequisites, Azure configuration, Kubernetes deployment, API usage, payload examples, and troubleshooting. Include diagrams and example workflows.
tasks.testStrategy: Have another developer follow documentation to set up. Verify all steps are clear. Check examples work. Validate troubleshooting section.

tasks.title: Create E2E Test Suite for MVP
tasks.description: Build end-to-end tests covering CREATE and DELETE operations from API to Azure deployment
tasks.details: Use Playwright to test: API payload submission, workflow triggering, Azure resource creation, status retrieval, and deletion. Test success and failure scenarios.
tasks.testStrategy: Run E2E tests against test environment. Verify all scenarios pass. Check test cleanup of resources. Validate test reporting.

tasks.title: Implement Basic Dashboard View
tasks.description: Create simple dashboard to list deployed Container Apps with status and quick actions
tasks.details: Build dashboard page showing all Container Apps. Display name, status, FQDN, last deployment time. Add delete button. Implement auto-refresh for status updates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard with multiple apps. Verify status updates. Check delete action works. Validate responsive design. Test error states.

tasks.title: Add Resource Group Management
tasks.description: Implement logic to create resource groups if they don't exist during Container App provisioning
tasks.details: Add pre-deployment step in workflow to check if resource group exists. Create if missing using Azure CLI. Apply appropriate tags. Handle permissions issues gracefully.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with non-existent resource group. Verify creation with correct tags. Test with existing resource group. Check permission errors are handled.

tasks.title: Optimize Workflow Performance
tasks.description: Analyze and optimize workflow execution time to meet <5 minute deployment target
tasks.details: Profile workflow execution times. Identify bottlenecks. Implement parallel steps where possible. Optimize Azure CLI commands. Add caching for container images.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure baseline execution time. Implement optimizations. Re-measure and verify improvement. Ensure functionality is not broken. Document performance gains.

metadata.projectName: Azure Container Apps as a Service
